fieldguide.minecraft.wandering_trader.de:
Look at his shit-eating grin. He knows there's nothing you can do to him. He's bullying you and you are HELPLESS.

Kill Him.

Kill Him NOW.

He won't see death coming. This is what you came for, wasn't it? A climatic bloodletting, where men are reduced to muscles and fury. These images speak to something gurgling deep within you.
